reported_success.quote: My replication attempt of the Curse of Knowledge in Reasoning About False Beliefs originally conducted by Susan Birch and Paul Bloom failed to replicate (Birch & Bloom, 2007).

notes: Values are supplied by the primary project authors in processed_data.csv, including author-computed d and p columns; no extractor conversion. Table sample N is preserved under its explicit column name and is not assumed to be analytic n. Narrative success not inferred from coded success columns. Study/sample/test matching requires linked report or paper confirmation. Original paper prints p_rep=.95, not a conventional p-value; conventional p is left null. Text parser renders equality signs as 5. Original blue and red outcomes are distinct. Primary table birch2007_2 selects red-container test; blue-container test is separately printed in the linked report and extracted here to match the supplied outcome.
